english.title: Personal licence holder fail to deliver licence to Licensing Authority w/i 14 days - Licensing
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being the holder of a personal licence under the Licensing Act 2003, failed, without reasonable excuse, to deliver the licence to the relevant licensing authority, namely **(..SPECIFY THE LICENSING AUTHORITY..), within fourteen days of being notified of the requirement to do so
